description: One representative recorded-pose clip for each of the 156 fault conditions, with aggregate dataset repetition counts.
count_scope: Final QuadFDB benchmark dataset counts; presentation videos were prepared from an earlier collection snapshot and do not define final flight counts.

overview.short_clip_rule: Each shorter recorded clip repeats its own supported frames; no pose extrapolation.

camera.animated_bound_rule: Exact complete native CAD arbitrary blade-phase envelope; independent CPU audit

selected_replay.scope: One presentation clip from a representative flight per fault condition, preserving the displayed interval in full.
selected_replay.loading: Only the selected video is loaded by the replay player.

rendering_theme.headlight: Original diffuse0.6/ambient0.5/specular0 retained; no added fill.
